blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Brooke Van Sickle and Myla Pablo kept Nxled unbeaten in two games after fending off Farm Fresh in a five-set thriller, 25-19, 25-17, 23-25, 20-25, 15-12, in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Saturday at Filoil EcoOil Centre in San Juan. Van Sickle continued to show her MVP form in return from a shoulder injury, leading the Chameleons with 20 points off 14 kills and six blocks, laced with 16 digs and nine excellent receptions to force a share of a 2-0 lead with Choco Mucho.
